title: Streamlining City Services
summary:
*   City officials held a special worksession to discuss a "Briefing Plan for Consolidations" across various departments.
*   The primary focus was on potential mergers or restructuring involving Emergency Medical Services (EMS), the Fire Department, and Wastewater Utility.
*   The meeting was a planning and discussion session, with presentations from city management and department directors, and did not involve final policy decisions or public hearings.

Councilmember Nofziger called to order the special called meeting of the Council, noting
that Mayor Todd would arrive shortly, and the absence of Mayor Pro Tem Urdy. He announced
the purpose of the meeting was to hold a worksession to discuss the Briefing Plan for
Consolidations.
Byron Marshall, First Assistant City Manager, introduced discussion of the Briefing Plan
for Consolidations. Further discussion and explanations of the plan were presented by
David Wuertz, Director, Emergency Medical Services; Fire Chief Bill Roberts; and Randy
Goss, Director of Wastewater Utility. A copy of the Plan is on file in the City Clerk's
office.
After presentations and questions by Council, the meeting was adjourned at 3:24 P.M.
